address: 8206 Turkey Creek Rd, Plant City, FL 33567

owner.name: Joseph Dages
owner.bio: Joseph Dages has been climbing trees across the Tampa Bay area for over 25 years — long enough to know which cuts save a tree and which storms actually call for a crane instead of a chainsaw. Dages Services is family-run, based right here in Plant City, serving Hillsborough, Pinellas, Manatee, Polk, and Pasco counties. Licensed and insured, and when you call, you're talking to Joseph — not a call center, not a dispatcher, just the guy who's going to show up and do the work.

hero.headline: Tree work, handled by the guy who answers his own phone.
hero.subheadline: Tree removal, trimming, stump grinding, storm cleanup, and hazardous work — serving Plant City and the greater Tampa Bay area. Fill out the form and Joseph calls you back, usually within minutes.
